onDeleteOptions.setNull: SET NULL - Set children to NULL when parent is deleted
onDeleteOptions.restrict: RESTRICT - Prevent deletion if children exist

onUpdateOptions.setNull: SET NULL - Set children to NULL when parent is updated

intro.title: 🎯 What is DiagramFlow?
intro.description: DiagramFlow is a collaborative tool for creating database ERD (Entity Relationship Diagrams) easily and quickly.

quickStart.title: 🚀 Quick Start
quickStart.step1: Add Table: Click the "📊 + Add Table" button in the left sidebar
quickStart.step2: Edit Table: Click or right-click on a table to edit it
quickStart.step3: Add Column: Click the "Add Column" button in the table edit screen
quickStart.step4: Set PK: Check the "🔑 PK" checkbox in the column row
quickStart.step5: Connect Relationships: After creating 2+ tables, click the "🔗 + Add Relationship" button

tableManagement.title: 📊 Table Management
tableManagement.description: Drag tables to freely arrange them, and set column types and attributes.

relationships.title: 🔗 Relationships
relationships.description: Visually represent 1:1, 1:N, N:N relationships and automatically generate foreign keys.

autoSave.title: 💾 Auto Save
autoSave.description: Automatically save your work locally and to the server for later retrieval.

ddlExport.title: 📤 DDL Export
ddlExport.description: Convert your ERD to MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle SQL DDL code.

icons.title: 🎨 Icon Description
icons.pk: 🔑 PK: Primary Key - Unique identifier for the table
icons.fk: 🔗 FK: Foreign Key - Key referencing another table
icons.nn: NN: Not Null - Does not allow NULL values

tips.title: 💡 Tips
tips.tip1: Right-click on a table to see edit/delete menu
tips.tip2: Click on a relationship line to edit the relationship settings
tips.tip3: All changes are automatically saved (no save button required)
tips.tip4: If multiple users work simultaneously and version conflicts occur, merge options are provided

q1.question: Q: How do I delete a table?
q1.answer: A: Right-click on the table and select "Delete", or delete it from the table edit modal.

q2.question: Q: Can I designate multiple columns as PK?
q2.answer: A: Yes, you can create a Composite Primary Key.

q3.question: Q: Where are saved diagrams?
q3.answer: A: Click the "📂 Load" button to see the list of saved diagrams.
